title: Bakery Business Kit: 25 Editable Menu, Order Form, Customer Card and Social Media Templates
description:
Give your bakery a coordinated look from the first menu browse to the final thank-you card. I put together 25 editable layouts in warm cream, cocoa, blush and sage, with bakery illustrations and clear spaces for your own details.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
One ZIP containing:
• 3 editable PowerPoint (PPTX) files with 25 different layouts
• 2 sample PDFs: 8 A4 document pages and 6 customer cards
• 25 unwatermarked PNG previews
• Editing instructions and a one-business licence

8 A4 BUSINESS DOCUMENTS
Menu, cake price guide, order request, order confirmation, weekly order planner, custom cake brief, market day checklist and bakery quote.

6 CUSTOMER CARDS — 5 × 3.5 INCHES
Thank you, storage & serving, ready for pickup, a little gift, your kind words and hello, we bake.

11 SQUARE SOCIAL POSTS
The new menu, taking orders, fully booked, weekend special, made to celebrate, kind words, behind the bake, pickup reminder, seasonal favourites, meet the baker and sold out.

HOW TO PERSONALISE
Open the PPTX in a compatible presentation editor. Replace YOUR BAKERY and every bracketed placeholder with your own name, prices, product details and contact information. Text boxes, lines, shapes and embedded illustrations are separate objects; longer wording may need manual resizing. For photo pages, insert and crop your own photograph, then delete the placeholder wording and shapes. These are ordinary shapes, not automatic photo frames. No photographs are included.

The files use Times New Roman and Arial. Font substitution and editing applications may affect spacing, so check every finished page. File structure, import and authoring renders were checked; native PowerPoint rendering has not been verified. No Canva account or template link is included or required.

SIZES AND EXPORTS
Documents: A4 portrait, 210 × 297 mm.
Cards: 5 × 3.5 inches, one card per page.
Social posts: square; export your finished posts at 1080 × 1080 px.
Document/card PNG previews are rendered at 300 dpi; social previews are 1080 × 1080 px. PDFs and PNGs still contain sample placeholders and are not editable or fillable forms. Edit the PPTX first, then export your personalised file. Print a proof at Actual Size before a larger run. No bleed, crop marks or multi-card sheet imposition are included.

DOWNLOAD
Download the Etsy delivery PDF, open its Google Drive link, then download and unzip your files. Access your Etsy downloads in a web browser.

PLEASE NOTE
Digital files only. No printed items, food, photographs, devices or styling props are included. This is a self-editing template set, not a personalisation service. Five coordinated bakery illustrations are reused across the 25 layouts; this is not a pack of 25 different illustrations. Styled listing mockups demonstrate possible use; image 2 shows the exact supplied layouts. Downloaded files have no advertising watermarks.

Forms use manual entries: no automatic calculations, spreadsheet or order-management software. The quote page is not a tax invoice. Set storage/serving details for your actual products and add only genuine customer reviews used with permission.

ONE BUSINESS USE
Personalise, print and post finished designs for your own single bakery business. You may send your personalised final PDF to a print shop for that business. Do not resell, redistribute, share or sublicense the templates, blank layouts, source files or extracted artwork. No template-resale or clipart-resale rights are included.

The five bakery illustrations were created with AI assistance and selected for this collection. Please message Pinogri on Etsy for file support.
